snippet.title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis - MathChief's Game Expo 2022 Trailer (Formerly UNRESTRICTED)
snippet.description:
This is our next challenge. 
The title was changed from UNRESTRICTED to UNDEFEATED: Genesis in The MIX Next in 2023.
This is the first in a series of sequels to UNDEFEATED.

[Steam store page]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/
Wishlist now and keep supporting us!

[Official X (Twitter)]
https://twitter.com/undefeated_game

▬▬▬▬▬▬

In 2019, our release "UNDEFEATED" was downloaded 1.50 million times.(As of the time of posting.)
This is our way of giving back to hero lovers around the world.

[About UNDEFEATED]
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116960/UNDEFEATED/
